title: Implement stateful aggregate tool-result budget in main query path
objective: Move aggregate per-message tool-result budget enforcement into the Go query loop with stable, persistent replacement decisions.
implementation_scope: Add ContentReplacementState with seenIds and replacements maps scoped per conversation thread.
Apply aggregate budget before microcompact and before provider request construction.
Group candidate tool results by API-wire user message boundaries, not only by local message objects.
Persist newly replaced records to transcript/session storage where resume can reconstruct them.
Reapply previous replacements byte-identically with no file I/O.
Skip image content and tools whose result-size contract should not be persisted.
Remove or narrow the current compact-path-only stateless EnforcePerMessageBudget so it does not diverge from the main path.
out_of_scope: Do not implement cached microcompact cache_edits in this task.
Do not redesign session storage beyond adding the minimum replacement records needed for resume.
acceptance_criteria: Repeated query-loop calls do not change already-seen tool-result replacement decisions.
Resume reconstruction freezes previously visible content and reapplies recorded replacements.
Parallel tool results in adjacent user messages are treated as one API-wire user message when appropriate.
Tests cover over-budget fresh results, frozen unreplaced results, reapplication, persistence failure, image skip, and resume.
risks: Prompt cache stability depends on exact replacement strings.
Session storage schemas may need migration-safe extension.
dispatch_prompt: Implement TS-like stateful per-message aggregate tool-result budget enforcement in the Go main query path, including resume-safe replacement records.
